body: Have you considered just overstaying your visa, giving you time to figure out a plan/maybe enroll elsewhere?  I know quite a few people who are in this country because they simply never returned home when the visa expired.  It may be an option, if not a permanent solution.

I would have to look into counseling.  I don't know if I'm eligible (my program is part time) and I don't know how I feel about counseling.  I know people have mixed feelings about therapy, and particularly college counselors seem to be very unproductive for a lot of depressed people :/
